title: Easy Mango Mousse

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: A quick dessert, possible year-round with canned mango pulp.

items: 1¾ lb mango pulp (800 g), canned or from ripe, sweet mangoes

steps.action: Pour into 6 small glasses; chill 30 min.

items: 6 oz good chocolate (170 g), grated or shaved
